programme.title: Auto China: Driving future of mobility
programme.desc: Auto China 2026 opens on April 24, showcasing nearly 1,500 vehicles over 10 days – at a pivotal turning point for China's automotive industry. programme.title: Two hearts, one journey: A girl and her dog
programme.desc: By early 2026, 11,760 certified dog trainers are registered in China. Wang Wenni is among them. Once an overseas student who abandoned illustration design due to poor health, she now works as a professional dog trainer and canine fitness specialist. Constantly learning, she proves this job delivers deep mind-body healing for both humans and dogs.

programme.title: Hammer and flame: Forging the past anew
programme.desc: Zou Qi, an inheritor of Longquan sword forging, is giving a fresh twist to a thousand-year-old craft. By transforming sword elements into everyday designs like fridge magnets and necklaces, she's bringing tradition into modern life in simple, creative ways. For her, real innovation means making tradition loved again. #JobTalks #ChinaEconFrontiers.

programme.title: Meet China Episode 4
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore the cutting edge of Chinese industry. We visit China’s first offshore spaceport to see rockets launch toward the stars and move to Hangzhou’s E-Fashion Town, where AI turns designs into reality in seconds. We also follow the \"fantastic journey\" of a bag of garbage as it transforms into energy and bricks with the help of industrial intelligence. Finally, we explore the \"emotional economy,\" where young people find solace in trendy toys and historical fragrances.
